description: This file defines a module for building and serializing XML/HTML trees using an ElementTree implementation. It includes classes for nodes, comments, document types, and document fragments, as well as functions for serialization and tree building.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents an XML/HTML element node with methods for attribute and child node management.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment node within the XML/HTML tree.

classes.name: DocumentType
classes.description: Represents a document type declaration node.

classes.name: TreeBuilder
classes.description: Builds and manages the XML/HTML tree structure, providing methods for serialization and document retrieval.

methods.name: getETreeBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a set of classes and functions for building and serializing XML/HTML trees based on a given ElementTree implementation.

methods.name: testSerializer
methods.description: Serializes an element to a string for testing purposes.

methods.name: tostring
methods.description: Serializes an element and its children to a string.
